added: Windows: VSync and Maximum FPS settings in the Display settings, saved and applied without a restart.
changed: Client updates reuse files you already have and download only what changed.
Windows: the FPS counter shows how many frames the client presents per second.
Windows: frame timing now follows your display's refresh rate or your Maximum FPS setting.
The ^4 blue in the Tab overlay is now a lighter blue.
fixed: Windows: mouse capture no longer fails after chat or the console when the cursor had left the window, and a failed capture now says why.
Page zoom from an earlier Ctrl+scroll no longer carries over between launches.
The picture stays sharp at fractional display scaling such as 125% or 150%.

added: Automatic client update notices in the menu show the available version and release notes, with Download, Install and Later options.
changed: Client and game updates now share one notice, with an option to refresh only the game.
fixed: Restored saving recorded demos, HUD/JSON exports and configuration files, including exports started during gameplay.
Fixed a Linux connection-retry timer that could show a connection failure after five minutes even when already connected.
Restored Linux client focus after a successful connection retry so mouse capture can resume without switching windows.

added: Right-click selected text to open a menu with a Copy option.
changed: Game update notices offer Refresh game or Keep playing, with a reminder in the menu.
fixed: Fixed a Windows client crash when opening maps and other dropdowns, including during multiplayer.
Prevented a Windows client crash when the game page has not finished drawing its first frame.
Website links now open in your default browser instead of being blocked by the SDL3/CEF client.

added: A QUIT button in the game menu closes the client.
changed: The Tab overlay highlights the world-record category for you or the player you are watching, with a YOU or WATCHING badge.
The Tab overlay displays smaller colored clan tags beside player names, with an underline for official clans.

added: Read the client changelog from Client updates, including offline release history and an indicator for unread release notes.
Automatic retries with a countdown and Retry now button when the server is temporarily unavailable.
changed: The Tab overlay shows spectators as separate labels and supports colored names and time differences versus the world record when supplied by the game.
fixed: Website links now open in your default browser instead of being blocked by the client.
Removed the duplicate game update popup so the client shows a single refresh notice.
